title: Swap the H3 video VAE to the int8_convrot build, R2-primary
description: Replace the MiniMax H3 video VAE dep (Comfy-Org fp16, 4.85GB) with Kijai's int8_convrot build (3.17GB). Fabio measured it on the bench 2026-08-10: faster, no quality loss. BLOCKED ON THE ENGINE BUMP - the int8_convrot VAE needs core >= v0.31.0 (PR #15334, merged 2026-08-06); shipped engine is v0.30.0, so merging this alone breaks H3 for every user. Bytes are mirrored to R2 as primary with Kijai HF as fallback, because the source is a 5-day-old repo literally named 'experimental' and a delete or a silent re-export would break every new install with no fallback today. The old fp16 dep entry is KEPT unreferenced so the orphan sweep reclaims 4.85GB from existing users.

attention.reason: Code complete and locally verified, but MUST NOT MERGE until the ComfyUI engine pin reaches v0.31.x - the int8_convrot VAE does not load on the shipped v0.30.0. Two checks still need the bumped engine: one real H3 generation through the app, and one clean install of the dep from R2.
